text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Capital markets will perform a significant role in Gulf Arab states' development in the next decade, banker says.
- Gulf Arab mediation committee ends second meeting in Riyadh on Qatar-Bahrain border dispute.
- Aluminium Bahrain plans an $80 million power expansion project, official says.
- Bahrain-based Gulf Aluminium Rolling Mill Co plans two expansion projects at a cost of $68 million.
- Bahrain Stock Exchange chairman says Bahrain, Oman, Kuwait, Egypt and Jordan plan to link their bourses.
